 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Mirror occupied panels across divider lines when the adjacent panel is empty."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    def cuts_and_segments(length, is_cut):
        cuts = [i for i in range(length) if is_cut(i)]
        segs, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut:
                segs.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < length:
            segs.append((start, length))
        return cuts, segs

    # Divider lines span the entire grid; they are the only complete rows/columns
    # of a non-background color.
    sep = None
    for color in range(1, 10):
        if any(all(v == color for v in row) for row in grid) and any(
            all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)
        ):
            sep = color
            break
    if sep is None:
        return out

    row_cuts, row_segs = cuts_and_segments(h, lambda r: all(v == sep for v in grid[r]))
    col_cuts, col_segs = cuts_and_segments(w, lambda c: all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h)))

    def cells(box):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = box
        return [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
                if out[r][c] not in (0, sep)]

    # Repeatedly complete neighboring reflected panels. The divider acts as
    # the mirror axis; equal-sized panels are required for an exact reflection.
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_segs):
            for ci in range(len(col_segs) - 1):
                c0, c1 = col_segs[ci]
                d0, d1 = col_segs[ci + 1]
                if c1 - c0 != d1 - d0:
                    continue
                a, b = (r0, r1, c0, c1), (r0, r1, d0, d1)
                ac, bc = cells(a), cells(b)
                if bool(ac) == bool(bc):
                    continue
                src, dst = (ac, b) if ac else (bc, a)
                sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = (r0, r1, c0, c1) if ac else (r0, r1, d0, d1)
                dr0, dr1, dc0, dc1 = dst
                for r, c in src:
                    rr = dr0 + (sr1 - 1 - r if False else r - sr0)
                    cc = dc0 + (sc1 - 1 - c)
                    out[rr][cc] = out[r][c]
                    changed = True
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_segs):
            for ri in range(len(row_segs) - 1):
                r0, r1 = row_segs[ri]
                d0, d1 = row_segs[ri + 1]
                if r1 - r0 != d1 - d0:
                    continue
                a, b = (r0, r1, c0, c1), (d0, d1, c0, c1)
                ac, bc = cells(a), cells(b)
                if bool(ac) == bool(bc):
                    continue
                src, dst = (ac, b) if ac else (bc, a)
                sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = (r0, r1, c0, c1) if ac else (d0, d1, c0, c1)
                dr0, dr1, dc0, dc1 = dst
                for r, c in src:
                    rr = dr0 + (sr1 - 1 - r)
                    cc = dc0 + (c - sc0)
                    out[rr][cc] = out[r][c]
                    changed = True
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))
